_doc: Endpoint-clean strands for the SGLT2 CKD topic. The served primary remains the trial-defined primary cardiorenal composite; this strand is a source-backed kidney-only decomposition from committed cached trial reports.
why_topic_is_suppressed: The served primary is not suppressed. This artifact separates the kidney-only strand from the CV-death-inclusive trial-defined primary composites so the kidney-only claim is not inferred from a cardiorenal endpoint.
